Foreign language/s assessment at the oral examination:
The admission examination does not include the assessment of English language
proficiency. Nonetheless, in order to successfully carry on the learning and
research activities of the PhD program, a B2-level (or higher) proficiency in English
Language/s is strongly recommended.
Admission exam:
The admission exam will be taken in: either in Italian or English, as preferred by
the candidate.
The candidate shall prepare a 10-minute presentation to introduce him/herself, to
explain the motivations to pursue a Ph.D. in Information Engineering, and to
discuss the main features of a possible research project on one of the topics of the
Examination topics Ph.D. School (http://www.dei.unipd.it/en/research/research-areas). The Admission
Committee will then discuss with the candidate the details of his/her academic
titles, curriculum, and research project and will assess if the candidate masters the
methodological tools needed to carry on the project.
